history.description: Project-local MCP server from the MDK monorepo's own @tetherto/mdk-mcp package, exposing site/fleet query and control tools (via examples/mvp-site's mcp-plugins/site plugin) over HTTP on localhost.
history.review_note: Reviewed provenance, transport/auth/host shape, and full tool surface (5 read-only + 1 write device/site tool from examples/mvp-site/backend/mcp-plugins/site). Accepted LOCAL_LOOPBACK_HTTP_TRANSPORT: server binds 127.0.0.1 only per its own source/README, no non-loopback exposure; medium risk from lack of TLS/auth accepted for local dev use.
history.source: First-party: the MDK monorepo's own @tetherto/mdk-mcp server (backend/core/mcp), registered as mdk-site in examples/full-site/.mcp.json and enabled locally for MDK stack development

playwright.description: Microsoft's official Playwright MCP server for browser automation (navigate, click, type, form-fill, snapshot/screenshot) via Claude Code's own MCP configuration.
playwright.review_note: Re-promotion after the prior approved record and registry entry were lost (approved copy and registry entry missing, likely from another concurrent session's cleanup; candidate file untouched, digest confirmed identical to the original review: sha256:cbe4d31b9b39a69f325872c55ef1571e174045bd60c60bb14f2d0ee00baeb28f). Same review as the original promotion: transport (stdio, no auth) and documented default tool surface (Core automation + Tab management only, no --caps passed); tool list is doc-sourced from the maintainers' README, not directly observed live, flagged in body for re-review once visible in a fresh session. Accepted risks unchanged: browser_run_code_unsafe (maintainer-documented RCE-equivalent, server-process-level arbitrary JS) and browser_evaluate (page-level eval) have no per-tool disable in Playwright MCP's capability model, so mitigation is procedural; local stdio transport risk accepted as before.
playwright.source: claude mcp add playwright --scope user npx @playwright/mcp@latest (microsoft/playwright-mcp, verified active via GitHub API 2026-09-06)
